thread:
samir: FYI auditor reached out asking for artifacts related to the Nov 3 API 503 spike. They want: retention windows, keystore/KMS access logs, a short repro we can run internally, and the billing delta for affected customers. tagging @elena @kevin for logs and repro.

elena: I can grab the keystore access logs slice. will export a signed bundle to S3 and share link. :link:

elena: export path will be s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025-11-03/api-503-keystore-slice-20251103.tar.gz (presigned link generated, will DM).

kevin: I pulled the runtime traces. quick repro for the 503 condition is a bad auth header + large concurrent prefix cache miss; here's a minimal repro we ran in staging:```bash
# simulate concurrent requests
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer STALE_TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"rw-16b","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
kevin: response pattern was ~70% 401 then brief cascade of 503s as workers rejected queued requests.

jordan: on the billing side, I matched a customer's invoice jump to the same 11/03 02:12-02:40 UTC window. attaching a redacted request sample from their traffic:```json
{"customer_id":"acct_XXX","route":"/v1/generate","tokens":1200,"status":503}
```
jordan: they saw ~3x token billing in our metering for a small subset where retries doubled token counts.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-20251103-42 (assigned to eng-runtime). runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-503-cascade

auditor-bot: Clarify please: what retention policy did these logs fall under, and can you confirm chain-of-custody for the exported bundle? auditor requests a signed hash and who performed the export.

elena: retention: keystore KMS logs retained 3 years for audit purposes (policy v2.1). access logs for the runtime are 2 years. I exported the bundle myself and uploaded to the S3 path above. sha256: 7f3c2a9b... (will DM full hash). export performed 2025-11-04T09:18Z by elena@redwood.

kevin: for repro steps in the evidence packet, include these notes: 1) stale token + retry loop causes auth backpressure, 2) concurrent KV cache miss path forces extra CPU/GPU context switches, 3) queued requests overflow worker pool and hit our negotiated 503 path. short mitigation: add 429 throttling on auth errors and improve early auth reject before scheduling.

samir: auditor also asked for timestamps slice and whether any KMS key rotation happened near the window. kevin/elena, did we rotate any key within +-7 days of the incident?

elena: no key rotations in that period. last rotation for the primary keystore key was 2025-09-10. recorded in key-manager logs.

auditor-bot: Please also attach an itemized timeline (who did what and when) for chain-of-custody. They prefer a table but short bullet list ok.

kevin: I'll draft the timeline: 2025-11-03 02:12 UTC - spike observed (alert); 02:15 - oncall paged; 02:20 - mitigations (retry throttling) applied; 11/04 09:18 - elena exported logs; 11/05 13:00 - evidence packet submitted to auditor.

jordan: added a billing note: I will include a CSV with metering rows for affected customers and a delta calc.

samir: great. I'll assemble the packet (timeline + sha256 + repro snippet + S3 link + billing CSV) and mark it as 'auditor packet v1' then route to compliance. will ping when uploaded. :thumbsup:
